title: Cosa hai fatto? Il mio racconto
summary: Week 5 capstone: passato prossimo storytelling with Marco, then layer 5 of the growing self-intro

blocks.title: Uno sguardo indietro: settimana 5
blocks.body: This week you learned the **passato prossimo**: with **avere** for most verbs (*ho parlato, ho fatto*), with **essere** for motion and reflexives, with **agreement** on the participle (*sono andata*), the most common **irregular participles**, and how to **choose the right auxiliary**. Plus the train and *timbrare*. Now let's put it all together.
blocks.callout: From here on, you can tell the story of anything you've done.

items.en: I went to the sea. (a woman)

lines.en: I went to the market on Saturday. (a woman)

blocks.prompt: Marco, about last night: 'I stayed home.' (he's a man) Which is correct?
blocks.explain: *Rimanere* takes essere; Marco is a man, so -o: *sono rimasto*.
*Prendere → preso* — irregular, one of the most common of all.

blocks.prompt: Type 'I woke up late.' (a woman speaking)
blocks.explain: *Mi sono svegliata tardi* — reflexive, essere, -a agreement.

blocks.prompt: Listen and type what you hear.
blocks.speak: Ho comprato del formaggio al mercato.
answers: ho comprato del formaggio al mercato
ho comprato del formaggio al mercato.

blocks.title: Check the auxiliary before you finish the sentence

pairs.right: *Sono rimasto/a* — essere, agrees with the subject
pairs.note: The auxiliary changes the rules — check it before you finish the sentence.

blocks.scene: At the bar, Marco wants to hear all about your week

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.nl: Allora, cosa hai fatto questa settimana? Raccontami tutto!
lines.en: So, what did you do this week? Tell me everything!

lines.speaker: You
lines.nl: Ho fatto un sacco di cose! Ho preso il treno e ho visitato il mercato.
lines.en: I did a ton of things! I took the train and visited the market.

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.nl: Bello! Hai comprato qualcosa di buono?
lines.en: Nice! Did you buy anything good?

lines.speaker: You
lines.nl: Sì, ho comprato del formaggio e ho parlato con un contadino simpatico.
lines.en: Yes, I bought some cheese and talked with a nice farmer.

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.en: And then? Did you do anything else?

lines.speaker: You
lines.nl: Ho letto un libro e ho dormito tanto — una settimana perfetta.
lines.en: I read a book and slept a lot — a perfect week.
lines.spotlight: All avere-verbs here: no agreement to worry about, even though several are irregular.

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.nl: Che invidia! Io invece sono rimasto in ufficio tutta la settimana.
lines.en: So jealous! I, on the other hand, stayed in the office all week.

lines.speaker: You
lines.nl: Magari vieni anche tu la prossima volta?
lines.en: Maybe you'll come too next time?

questions.q: What did 'You' buy at the market?
options: Cheese, and talked with a farmer

questions.q: Where did Marco stay all week?
